subject.title: fix(agents): stop runs at the critical tool-loop threshold

question: Should `plugins.entries.codex.config.appServer.loopDetectionPreToolUseRelay: false` remain the historical PreToolUse-only opt-out, or become the supported opt-out for the paired PreToolUse/PostToolUse loop-detection relay?
rationale: This existing configuration value has upgrade-visible semantics; source review cannot safely choose whether retaining post-tool loop-history completion is a compatibility contract or an intentional behavior change.

options.title: Preserve the narrow historical opt-out
options.body: Keep `false` limited to the loop-detection PreToolUse relay, retain any independently required PostToolUse relay behavior, and align tests and docs to that contract.

options.title: Adopt a paired relay opt-out
options.body: Treat `false` as disabling both loop-detection relays, document the deliberate behavior change, and provide upgrade-focused proof that existing Codex setups remain understandable.

recommendation.title: Preserve the narrow historical opt-out
recommendation.body: Keep `false` limited to the loop-detection PreToolUse relay, retain any independently required PostToolUse relay behavior, and align tests and docs to that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: A feature-history owner could not be established from the unavailable local history inspection; the choice requires an owner of the Codex configuration contract.
